content: Able au lar kemlam Zona erkepasameilu taba Ople Agudim.
E detauti, “Muige kari adud paikaige ka Agudim ererekri a E kara erer terpeida. Ka ererekri au muimui eudle paierlam a Ma kara erer tasri.
“Ma kari au karemge natimeda au muikakarem, nade able podagadgize kari narpomerda a mara dugdug zeuber kari tumge baraplare.
“Kage natkarti: “Mari erkeplam kari adem namarikdarda, ka umele ka iako erkepnakereder Mari zogozogo metaem.
“Able nide kari kemerkemer natkami eud maike, aukaremira mui kari nairumada. Meo kari kerimge arpomreder.
“Ka baitri nade paserira sip tadaramar, able gesepem ge kari kar narker niaiem epe mama kari nagimedari eudlam Ople ae kara Agud.
“Nade kara eded adem dorier, kage Mari nakepwari, Ople, a kara erkepasam baurwari Marim Mari zogo utebem.
“Netiba pe tag arsirarsir agudem kemerkemer tababu baiswereda, wipe bapekda Agudi upiatidarlam.
“Marim iaka auspirwed dakrier a ka iako Marim zegulu agimulu a kara nalu mir geka Mari nakwari kai akailu sikak obai. Azimwaret tikase Opleilam.”
A Oplelut able lar au aler detagri a ege Zonai adem ikeida watwet gesepge.
